name: Task Board
secret_hint: Another user's private tasks and admin-only user management must be out of reach for a normal member.
policy: Every /api route except /api/login requires a signed-in user. A user may read, change or delete only the tasks they own (tasks.owner_id is their id), including when listing tasks by user. Only users with role 'admin' may list or update users under /api/admin/.
